forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Application modules must not participate in circular dependencies.

forbidden.name: optional-local-tools-stay-outside-application-adapters
forbidden.comment: The optional local capture package may reuse bounded shared primitives but must not become an alternate frontend, hosted, server, or core CLI entry point.

forbidden.name: shared-contracts-stay-independent-of-domain-and-adapters
forbidden.comment: Canonical shared contracts may depend only on other contract modules and external type declarations, never on domain, runtime, adapter, tool, or presentation code.

forbidden.name: domain-packages-stay-independent-of-runtime-adapters
forbidden.comment: Evidence and collector-interface packages may use shared contracts and pure package peers but must not depend on application runtimes, tools, or presentation adapters.

forbidden.name: case-domain-stays-independent-of-runtime-adapters
forbidden.comment: The pure Case domain may reuse the exact bounded root-domain primitives retained for compatibility, but it must not reach runtime, tool, network, filesystem, environment, or presentation adapters.

forbidden.name: case-domain-no-node-core
forbidden.comment: The shared Case domain must remain equivalent in Node and browser runtimes and cannot import Node core modules.

forbidden.name: workspace-domain-stays-independent-of-runtime-adapters
forbidden.comment: Pure workspace collection behaviour may reuse shared package owners and the small allowlisted cross-runtime scoring and query primitives, but cannot reach runtime, tool, network, filesystem, environment, or presentation adapters.

forbidden.name: workspace-domain-no-node-core
forbidden.comment: Shared workspace collection behaviour must remain equivalent in browser and Node runtimes and cannot import Node core modules.

forbidden.name: portable-domain-packages-stay-independent-of-runtime-adapters
forbidden.comment: Monitoring, investigation, interchange, relationship, and comparison behaviour may reuse dependency-neutral package peers and the established pure cross-runtime primitives, but cannot reach runtime, tool, network, filesystem, environment, or presentation adapters.

forbidden.name: portable-domain-packages-no-node-core
forbidden.comment: Shared monitoring, investigation, interchange, relationship, and comparison behaviour must remain equivalent in browser and Node runtimes and cannot import Node core modules.

forbidden.name: cli-stays-out-of-frontend
forbidden.comment: Production CLI modules must obtain all behaviour from dependency-neutral owners and cannot reach frontend source through any path.

forbidden.name: non-frontend-production-stays-out-of-frontend
forbidden.comment: Shared libraries, packages, hosted functions, root server code, CLI code, and maintainer tools must obtain production behaviour from dependency-neutral owners and cannot reach frontend source through any path.

forbidden.name: non-frontend-production-stays-out-of-frontend-presentation
forbidden.comment: CLI, shared library, package, function, and maintainer-tool code must not import frontend routes or components.

forbidden.name: case-consumers-use-domain-owner
forbidden.comment: CLI, shared library, package, function, and maintainer-tool code must import Case behaviour from the shared domain owner rather than the historical frontend compatibility facades.

forbidden.name: workspace-consumers-use-domain-owner
forbidden.comment: Non-frontend consumers must import workspace collection behaviour from the shared owner rather than the historical frontend compatibility facades.

forbidden.name: portable-domain-consumers-use-shared-owner
forbidden.comment: Non-frontend consumers must import investigation artefact, interchange, and comparison behaviour from shared package owners rather than historical frontend compatibility facades.

forbidden.name: artifact-integrity-consumers-use-domain-owner
forbidden.comment: Non-frontend consumers must import canonicalisation and digest rules from the pure evidence-domain owner rather than the historical frontend facade.

forbidden.name: domain-control-consumers-use-domain-owner
forbidden.comment: Non-frontend consumers must import domain-control normalisation and manifest rules from the pure evidence owner rather than historical browser facades.

forbidden.name: observation-consumers-use-domain-owner
forbidden.comment: Production evidence consumers use the pure observation owner; the historical lib facade remains only for compatibility adapters and public imports.

forbidden.name: production-no-orphans
forbidden.comment: Shared, CLI, and browser-library modules must have an application consumer so obsolete production files cannot survive behind tests alone.

forbidden.name: frontend-no-server-only
forbidden.comment: Browser code must not reach server networking, secrets, authentication, filesystem, CLI, or function modules.

forbidden.name: frontend-no-node-core
forbidden.comment: Browser code must not import Node core modules.

forbidden.name: fast-compact-no-direct-deep-collector
forbidden.comment: Scheduled fast and compact entry points may use the guarded Lookup dispatcher but must not bypass it to call deep-only collectors.

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: Application imports must resolve under the locked TypeScript and workspace configuration.

required.name: provider-adapters-use-contract
required.comment: Optional intelligence adapters must depend directly on the provider-neutral evidence contract.
